divergence: All three runs passed with the same core procedure: a store-wide document-text scan for the counterparty name (T0 and T1 as extraction scripts, T2 as an archive-aware shell scan) surfaced the four matters at once; the agent read their engagement letters and credit agreements, then spent several stages ruling out matters whose hits were generic name fragments (in-matter scans, folder listings, spot reads), and wrote exactly the four matters. Repeated check stages re-read the response and sources without changing the answer.
